# Lasso for Final Variable Selection


```{r}
# Create global training and holdout subsets
train_prop <- 0.7
global_train_end <- ceiling(length(months) * train_prop)
train_mos <- months[1:global_train_end]
train_df <- full_df %>% filter(date %in% train_mos)
test_df <- full_df %>% filter(!(date %in% train_mos))



set.seed(10) # reproducibility
sample_train_df <- train_sample(df=train_df, p=0.06)

# Create design matrix and response vector
x_train <- model.matrix(reformulate(predictor_names), data=sample_train_df)
y_train <- sample_train_df$y

# Fit Lasso logistic regression
lasso_fit <- glmnet(x = x_train, y = y_train, family = binomial, 
                    alpha = 1) # alpha = 1 for Lasso
    
idx <- max(which(lasso_fit$df <= 10)) 
lambda_screen <- lasso_fit$lambda[idx]

coefs <- coef(lasso_fit, s = lambda_screen)
coefs

plot(lasso_fit, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
legend("topright", legend = rownames(lasso_fit$beta), 
       col = seq_len(nrow(lasso_fit$beta)), lwd = 1, cex = 0.6, bty = "n")


beta <- as.matrix(lasso_fit$beta)

coef_df <- data.frame(
  lambda = rep(log(lasso_fit$lambda), each = nrow(beta)),
  variable = rep(rownames(beta), times = length(lasso_fit$lambda)),
  coef = c(beta)
)

vars1 <- c("last_vix", "cr_spread", "deliq_num2")
vars2 <- c("loan_purposeN", "occupancy_statusP", "regionNortheast")

coef_small <- coef_df %>%
  filter(variable %in% c(vars1, vars2)) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    variable %in% vars1 ~ "Macro & delinquency",
    variable %in% vars2 ~ "Loan/region",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

ggplot(coef_small, aes(x = lambda, y = coef, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "log(lambda)", y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()



k <- 5

vars <- unique(coef_df$variable)

facet_map <- data.frame(
  variable = vars,
  facet_id = paste0("Group ", ceiling(seq_along(vars) / k))
)

coef_faceted <- coef_df %>%
  inner_join(facet_map, by = "variable")

ggplot(coef_faceted, aes(x = lambda, y = coef, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "log(lambda)", y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()



coef_df <- filter(coef_df, 
                  !(variable %in% c("(Intercept)", "deliq_num1", 
                                    "deliq_num2", "last_unrate_chg_pos", 
                                    "last_vix", "credit_score", "cr_spread")))
coef_df <- subset(coef_df, lambda < -8)

coef_df$coef_signed_log <- sign(coef_df$coef) * log1p(abs(coef_df$coef))

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = lambda, y = coef_signed_log, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size=1, alpha=0.9) +
  labs(x = "Log lambda", y = "Signed log(|coef| + 1)") + 
  theme_minimal()


```

We choose a cutoff of $\lambda=\lambda^\star=e^{-10}\approx 4.54$, so we drop `last_vtl_est`. We keep `loan_purpose` and `region` because not *all* indicators of the levels shrink to zero at $\lambda=\lambda^\star$.
